title: How the Maple Guide Works
author: Nexon MapleStory Support
summary: The official explanation of Maple Guide recommendations, level-based hunting fields, prerequisite quests, teleporting, and persistent job-advancement prompts.

sections.title: Recommendations
items: Maple Guide recommends quests and hunting fields based on character level.
Some destinations remain locked until related quests are completed.

sections.title: Travel
items: Select a recommended field to teleport when its conditions are met.
Use the guide to reduce repeated world-map navigation.

sections.title: Advancement reminders
items: A job-advancement button appears when the character is ready.
The prompt remains until the advancement quest is completed.

notes: Official support article verified in Chrome on 2026-07-27.
steps: Use the advancement prompt when it appears.
